notes:
Summary: RidgeGate is a mid-market product company building an in-app AI assistant (support & doc search). They want to validate Hosted API quickly, then move to Dedicated/VPC for data residency and auditability.

Key quotes: "We need audit logs surfaced to our SIEM within 48h"; "SSO is non-negotiable — SAML + SCIM provisioning".

POC: 2-week proof-of-concept underway (embeddings + chat). Using anonymized support corpus (~200k docs). Focus metrics: recall@10 for search, median latency <120ms for embeddings, cost target ~0.01$/query.

Security asks: SOC2 Type II report (in progress), architecture for Dedicated in VPC, KMS/HSM integration for key ownership, per-token logging with retention policies, ability to set retention to 90/365/forever per dataset. RidgeGate legal flagged DPA + data residency clause for EU customers.

Decision drivers: reliability/latency, unit economics at scale, and clean handoff for audit logs to their Splunk workspace. They like Redwood's routing/fallback story (hosted -> dedicated), but need concrete SOC2 evidence and a KMS plan before procurement.

Internal action items: draft DPA + EU residency appendix, create Dedicated infra diagram (Priya), schedule security deep-dive w/ infra + legal (target 2026-03-18).
use_case_summary: Primary: in-product conversational support + contextual doc search. Secondary: automated summarization of tickets and reranking of KB answers. Expect to generate embeddings for 200k docs and serve ~500k queries/month initially.
security_review_notes: Security team: requesting SOC2 Type II (latest), list of subservice orgs, audit log schema and retention controls. Also asked for SSO/SAML metadata and SCIM provisioning docs. Redwood to confirm KMS options (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed) and timeline to HSM integration. Legal: DPA redline in progress; requested data residency clause for EU customers.
